blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor, Manila Rep. Joel Chua, has questioned the defense panel’s comparison of Vice President Sara Duterte to her predecessor, Leni Robredo, saying that the reason why the latter was not impeached was that there was really no impeachable offense committed to begin with. In a press briefing on Thursday, Chua, who is also spokesperson for the prosecution team, said it is unfair to make insinuations that Duterte is experiencing political harassment while it supposedly did not happen to Robredo when former President Rodrigo Duterte, the VP’s father, was in office.
